method: Coordinates prioritize operator-published GPS, then a named campground point matched to the current operator address, and finally a current destination or regional tourism listing when no usable operator map exists. Seattle routes use OSRM from central Seattle to the reviewed arrival point. Public estimates round upward for towing, traffic, mountain roads, and ferry queues; the measured baseline remains in the canonical record.

reviews.coordinate_source: Current KOA address matched to the named Leavenworth/Pine Village KOA point and operator entrance directions
reviews.route_note: Fastest normal all-road route at review time; public estimate adds a towing, traffic, and mountain-pass margin. Follow KOA's current Zelt Strasse entrance directions rather than the former Riverbend Drive address.

reviews.route_note: Fastest normal all-road route at review time; public estimate adds a towing, traffic, and mountain-road margin. The campground is north of Leavenworth near the Chiwawa River, not in the Icicle Creek valley.

reviews.coordinate_source: Named campground point matched to the Port of South Whidbey address and long-vehicle entrance instructions at Fairgrounds Road
reviews.route_note: Routing baseline uses the Mukilteo-Clinton ferry and excludes unusually long terminal queues. Public estimate adds towing, boarding, and typical queue margin; travelers should check live ferry conditions. The stable no-ferry route via Deception Pass measured about 180 minutes and 126 miles.
